title: Apply for a driver licence with an interlock condition
summary: Learn how to apply for a NSW driver licence that includes an interlock condition if you have been ordered to participate in the Alcohol Interlock Program.
intro:
If you've been given an order to participate in the Alcohol Interlock Program, you must be issued a NSW licence with an interlock condition. You need to visit a Service NSW Centre to apply for the licence.

You can do this once you:
who_can_apply: You must have been given an order to participate in the Alcohol Interlock Program.
what_you_need: Payment for any licence and program fees (concessions and financial assistance are available)
Passing any knowledge or practical tests, including an eyesight test, required for the type of licence

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the required forms.
Make sure you have all your documentation, including proof of identity and proof of concession (if applicable).
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: You cannot apply for a learner rider licence if you're subject to an interlock order.

faqs.q: Where do I apply for a licence with an interlock condition?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to apply for the licence.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, payment for any licence and program fees, your concession card (if applicable), and to pass any required knowledge, practical, and eyesight tests.

faqs.q: What are the steps to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: First, download and complete the required forms. Next, gather all your documentation, including proof of identity and proof of concession. Finally, visit a service centre and submit your application.
